---
title: "Command-line scripts in `utilities` directory"
---


The `utilities/` has the following scripts for working with `arsgrammatica`. For details on usage, run the script with the help option, `-h`.




## Analyzing texts


- `analyze_ctsdata_to_files.py`: Analyze a `#!ctsdata` corpus and write each sentence's analysis to its own file.
- `analyze_tokendata_to_files.py`: Analyze already-tokenized files and write each sentence's analysis to its own file.
- `analyze_tokendata_w_diagrams.py`: Run analysis plus PNG diagramming, starting from already-tokenized files.
- `analyze_w_diagrams.py`: Run the full pipeline from a `#!ctsdata` source file to diagrams (tokenize, analyze, diagram) in one command.
- `group_ctsdata_by_sentence.py`: Group a corpus's passages into runs that each begin and end on a sentence boundary.
- `tokenize_ctsdata.py`: Tokenize a `#!ctsdata` corpus and split it into sentences, with no syntax analysis.


## Visualization

- `analyses_to_dot_pngs.py`: Render every sentence in one or more saved analysis files as Graphviz PNG diagrams.
- `analysis_to_displacy.py`: Render a saved analysis file's tokengraph as a self-contained displaCy-style HTML diagram.
- `analysis_to_dot.py`: Render a saved analysis file's tokengraph as Graphviz DOT source.



## Cost management

- `calibrate_max_tokens.py`: Calibrate `token_budget.py`'s `max_tokens` estimate against real LM output.
- `diagnose_max_tokens.py`: One-off check of whether passing `max_tokens` triggers the proxy's 405 error.
- `diagnose_proxy_raw.py`: Send a raw stdlib HTTP request to the litellm proxy to tell client-library problems from server problems.
- `estimate_corpus_cost.py`: Estimate the LM cost of analyzing a whole corpus from a random sample of passages.

## Optimizing models

- `model_bakeoff.py`: Compare how well candidate task models, mainly open-weight ones, perform on `SentenceAnalysis`.
- `optimize_gepa.py`: Optimize the `SentenceAnalysis` prompt with dspy.GEPA against the gold examples.
- `analysis_to_gold_example.py`: Convert a reviewed analysis file into ready-to-paste `GoldExample` Python source.




## Documentation


- `build_api_docs.py`: Regenerate the single-page pdoc API reference in `docs/arsgrammatica-api-docs.html`.
